infobox.leads to: Textile - Part 1, Sew it Good - Part 3, Collector

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Sew it Good - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Well, looks like I’m through with armor, took a bit of an effort, though. If I need some more, you’ll help me out, right? Anyway, now I have to get my hands on tactical rigs, and some of them are pretty hard to come by, but you’ll pull through, right? I need grey BlackRocks and green TVs. Bring at least a couple of each, and it'll be fine. Look for them yourself though, no traders, okay?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 2 WARTECH TV-109 + TV-106 chest rigs in raid
- Hand over the chest rigs
- Find 2 BlackRock chest rigs in raid
- Hand over the chest rigs

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +18,500 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.03
- 30,000 Roubles
  - 31,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 34,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× ANA Tactical M2 plate carrier (OD Green)
- 1× Oakley Mechanism heavy duty backpack (Black)
- Unlocks craft for 5.11 Tactical TacTec plate carrier (Ranger Green) at Lavatory level 3
"Thank you heartily, bro! Put them somewhere in the corner, I'll take a look later. I'm done with garment manufacture for now, gotta deal with something else first."
